name: measurements
title: Measurements

fields.name: tag_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the tag. Foreign key to [`tags.tag_id`](/GeoLocator-DP/core/tags#tag_id).

categories.label: Light-level values measured by a solar geolocator. Range and units may vary by provider and tag settings.

Measure of movement performed by the bird, computed from acceleration sensors. Range and computation method may vary by tag provider, model, settings, and placement on the animal. In general, higher values indicate more activity. Typically computed as the cumulative sum of the absolute difference of acceleration along the z-axis. See [doi:10.1186/s40462-018-0137-1](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40462-018-0137-1) (SOI), [doi:10.1111/jav.01068](https://doi.org/10.1111/jav.01068) (Lund), and the [migratetech report](https://www.migratetech.co.uk/IntigeoSummary.pdf) for more details.

Mean acceleration along the z-axis, computed from acceleration sensors. Mainly used by SOI devices. This metric is sometimes used as a proxy for pitch and was named `pitch` in GeoLocator DP versions earlier than v1.0.
Temperature measured by the tag sensor located between the tag and the animal (body temperature). Units: degrees Celsius.
Temperature measured by the tag sensor pointing outward from the animal (air temperature). This typically corresponds to the main external temperature sensor. Units: degrees Celsius.
Acceleration measured by the tag along the X axis of the forward-right-down frame. Units: g (standard gravity, 1 g = 9.80665 m/s^2).
Acceleration measured by the tag along the Y axis of the forward-right-down frame. Units: g (standard gravity, 1 g = 9.80665 m/s^2).
Acceleration measured by the tag along the Z axis of the forward-right-down frame. Units: g (standard gravity, 1 g = 9.80665 m/s^2).
Magnetic field strength measured by the magnetometer along the X axis of the forward-right-down frame. Units: gauss (1 G = 100 microtesla).
Magnetic field strength measured by the magnetometer along the Y axis of the forward-right-down frame. Units: gauss (1 G = 100 microtesla).
Magnetic field strength measured by the magnetometer along the Z axis of the forward-right-down frame. Units: gauss (1 G = 100 microtesla).
Wet count during a measurement interval from the wet-dry sensor. Units are usually device-specific.
Conductivity measured by the wet-dry sensor. Unit varies by model.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: Date and time of the measurement. Accepts any valid [ISO 8601](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) datetime string, including datetime in local time (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm`), in UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`) or any specific timezone (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm+hh:mm`).

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value of the measurement taken by the sensor.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Labeling of pressure and acceleration data according to the [labeling chapter of the GeoPressureManual](https://geopressure.org/GeoPressureManual/labelling-tracks.html).
